classification.difficultyReason: Apply the familiar coin or single-face die probability to each supplied trial count.

children.prompt: If I throw a fair coin 10 times, how many times would you expect it to land on heads?

children.label: e
children.prompt: If I roll a fair die 600 times, how many times would you expect it to land on the number 1?

answer.worked:
Using a standard six-sided die numbered 1–6:
$$P(1)=\frac16$$
$$\begin{align*}f&=np\\f&=600\times\frac16\\f&=100\end{align*}$$
Expected frequency: 100 times.
